recommendations.message: Inspect the blocking chain and launch order before widening the fleet.
recommendations.caveat: Blocked time before launch can exceed launched lifetime and overlaps queue wait; it does not identify which predecessor should have run first.

recommendations.message: Inspect repeated verification evidence and repair scope.
recommendations.caveat: Consecutive failed records share a fingerprint, not necessarily a root cause.

recommendations.message: Ready work is waiting on an operator Land click; enable auto.land or inspect delivery checks.
recommendations.caveat: Observed ready-to-land delay does not establish which delivery dependency caused it.

recommendations.message: Inspect review-phase token share; narrow review scope or model tier if review dominates attributed spend.
recommendations.caveat: Review-phase tokens include coordinator-session spend during review and are not exclusively reviewer cost.

recommendations.message: Inspect reviewer failure evidence, provider capacity and revision churn.
recommendations.caveat: Failed review operations are not completed rounds or proof of defects.

recommendations.message: Inspect relaunch causes before assuming restarts are routine.
recommendations.caveat: Recorded relaunches include deliberate operator relaunches; churn does not prove pane death or wasted execution.

stalls.caveat: Missions whose samples carry no problem (logs and producers from before it was recorded) count every quota hold as quota, provider rate limits included. Capacity waits and Recovery deferrals are timed from the events the board appends: nothing before they were recorded counts, and board downtime inside an open wait does. Launch refusals count only attempts that failed. Producer review failures can include provider-capacity failures. Offline, problem and deferral time can overlap.
